title: 第1996章 糟了煮熟的鸭子要飞第1995章 白日梦少做赴约
slug: 系统伴我成长助我无敌永生
lines: “还能有谁……当然是你这个……嘿嘿！带刀侍卫，你终于来了啊！
本公主刚刚只是在……在……在说什么？哦，对了，是绝对不会放过任何一个可以恢复肉身的机会，嗯，就是这样。”
“是吗？还以为七公主在说绝对不会放过本尊呢？”
一道身影在离雪天后十丈开外凝聚。
来者正是林羽。
“哪里？你肯定误会了，你现在是本公主的希望，本公主又岂敢得罪你这个未来大恩人。”
林羽一本正经点头
“没有就好。”
呼！
雪天后暗暗佩服自己，能急中生智。
刚刚差点嘴瓢了。
要是被这个家伙听到本公主不是，那他岂会尽心尽力做事？
嗯？
不行，得让她知道自己不是好惹的。
“哼！带刀侍卫，本公主已经等你几天了，我长这么大，还没有人敢让本公主等的，你……你迟到了。”
林羽轻瞥着她
“什么带刀侍卫？你还真把本尊当成你的侍卫？
还有，记得上次约定是一年，今天刚好是约定日期。
另外，本尊当时说话时辰是申时，现在不过午时，迟到之说何来？你倒不如说自己来早要恰当。”
额！
这个家伙……雪天后承认，确实是她来早了。
不过，她也是担心某个贪财好宝的家伙失约，又或者他来了没看到她又立马跑路。
故此，她才刻意来早点蹲守着对方。
雪天后当公主惯了，脾气可不小。
她才不会承认自己责怪错人。
林羽见她脸色变幻无常，懒得听她扯东扯西，当即，直言主题。
“雪天后，别扯犊子了，直奔主题吧，本尊要你筹备资源进展如何？”
“哼！贪婪的家伙，本公主当然不会让你失望，当然，你也不能让本公主失望。
要是事情办砸了，本公主……绝对不会原谅你的。”
咻！
数枚储物戒疾射而去。
林羽眼眸底闪过异色，抬手接住。
旋即，他道念探视。
嗯？
好家伙！
content_en:
"Who else... Of course it's you... Hehe! Guard with a sword, you are finally here!
What was this princess just...saying...? Oh, by the way, I will never miss any opportunity to recover my physical body, well, that's it. "
"Really? You thought the Seventh Princess was saying that she would never let me go?"
A figure condensed ten feet away from Li Xuetian.
It was Lin Yu who came.
"Where? You must have misunderstood. You are my princess's hope now. How can I dare to offend you, my future benefactor?"
Lin Yu nodded seriously.
"It's fine if you don't."
Phew!
The Snow Queen secretly admired herself for being able to become wise in a hurry.
I almost lost my temper just now.
If this guy hears that this princess is not good, then how can he do his best?
Um?
No, you have to let her know that she is not someone to be trifled with.
"Hmph! Guard with sword, this princess has been waiting for you for a few days. No one dares to make me wait for my age. You... you are late."
Lin Yu glanced at her lightly
"What kind of guard with a sword? Do you really think of me as your guard?"
Also, remember that the last agreement was for one year, and today happens to be the agreed date.
In addition, the time when I spoke was Shen Shi, but now it is noon, so where does the saying of being late come from? It would be more appropriate for you to say that you came early. "
Uh!
This guy...Xue Tianhou admitted that she was indeed early.
However, she was also worried that some guy who was greedy for money would break the appointment, or that he would run away without seeing her when he arrived.
Therefore, she deliberately came early to guard the other party.
The Snow Queen is used to being a princess, and she has quite a temper.
She would never admit that she blamed the wrong person.
Lin Yu saw her expression changing and was too lazy to listen to her ramblings, so he immediately spoke out about the topic.
"Snow Queen, stop talking nonsense and get straight to the point. How is the progress of preparing the resources I want you to do?"
"Hmph! Greedy guy, of course I won't let you down, and of course you can't let me down either.
If things go wrong, this princess... will never forgive you. "
Phew!
Several storage items were quickly shot away.
Lin Yu's eyes flashed with strange color, and he raised his hand to catch it.
Immediately, he thought about visiting.
Um?
Good guy!
title_en: Chapter 1996: Damn, the cooked duck will fly Chapter 1995: Stop daydreaming and keep up with appointments
